name: Color Treated Hair
description: Hair that has been chemically treated with hair dye, highlighting, or bleach to change its color. This type of hair is typically more prone to damage and requires specific care to maintain health and appearance.
porosity: Generally high due to the damage from coloring processes
characteristics: Increased porosity leading to faster moisture loss
common_problems: Tendency for breakage and split ends
Color fading or uneven color distribution
recommended_ingredients: Hydrating ingredients like hyaluronic acid, glycerin, and aloe vera
Moisturizing agents such as shea butter and coconut oil
washing_frequency: No more than twice a week, with gentle color-safe products
oil_recommendation: Use lightweight oils like argan or jojoba oil for added shine and protection

morning_routine.action: Apply a small amount of leave-in conditioner to damp hair
morning_routine.purpose: To hydrate and protect hair from styling tools

night_routine.action: Rinse out the leave-in conditioner with cool water
night_routine.purpose: To seal in moisture and prevent excessive heat exposure during sleep

night_routine.action: Apply a heat protectant before using any styling tools
night_routine.purpose: To shield hair from damage caused by high temperatures

weekly_care: Deep conditioning treatments are recommended once a week to restore moisture and strength
heat_styling_recommendation: Limit heat styling or use low-temperature settings when necessary
lifestyle_tips: Wear protective hairstyles like braids or buns to reduce tension on hair
Use wide-tooth combs and avoid harsh brushing
foods_for_healthy_hair: Nuts and seeds for vitamins and minerals
common_mistakes: Over-washing hair, leading to more dryness and damage
Using harsh chemicals or heat styling tools excessively
do: Protect hair from sun exposure by wearing a hat
dont: Avoid using too much product that can weigh down color-treated hair
Do not sleep with your head on a pillowcase made of rough fabric, as it can irritate the scalp and lead to breakage

seasonal_care.summer: Use lighter products and avoid direct sunlight to prevent excessive drying and damage
seasonal_care.winter: Focus on hydrating hair more frequently due to increased dryness from cold weather and indoor heating
seasonal_care.monsoon: Protect hair from moisture and humidity, as this can lead to increased breakage

expert_tips: Consider using a color protecting spray or treatment for added longevity of your color
Regular trims can help maintain the health and appearance of your colored hair by removing split ends
